def answer_query(image, query):
    # Initialize the ImagePatch object
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)

    # Split the query into individual words
    query_words = query.split()

    # Find patches matching each word in the query
    patches = [image_patch.find(word) for word in query_words]

    # Flatten the list of patches
    patches = [patch for sublist in patches for patch in sublist]

    # If no patches were found, return a failure message
    if not patches:
        return "No matching patches found."

    # Sort the patches by their distance from the center of the image
    patches.sort(key=lambda patch: distance(patch, image_patch))

    # Get the best text match for the query from the closest patch
    best_match = patches[0].best_text_match(query_words)

    return best_match

modern_c3_q7.program:
def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    man_patches = image_patch.find("man")
    print_patches = image_patch.find("print")
    
    if not man_patches or not print_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    man_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in man_patches]
    print_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in print_patches]
    
    min_distance = float('inf')
    closest_man = None
    
    for man, man_center in zip(man_patches, man_centers):
        for print_patch, print_center in zip(print_patches, print_centers):
            dist = abs(man_center - print_center)
            if dist < min_distance:
                min_distance = dist
                closest_man = man
    
    return closest_man
